Name: Simple Town Chatter (Big Update) Again
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Town Chatter ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#A7F3D0]A little conversation as the valley goes about its day.[/color][/b][/center]

[center]Hear character-specific remarks, friendly hellos and short conversations from the 34 original friendship villagers. Your farmer can answer, greet their animals and share a morning exchange with their spouse. Choose how lively you want the valley to feel.[/center]
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff7700]Now With A Total Of 5,251 Dialogue Entries[/color]
[/b] [/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌟 The complete 1.9 update[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][b]One combined feature update covering versions 1.4–1.9.[/b]
Farmer replies, friendship-based conversations, birthdays, animals, morning greetings, better reading time and local chat history are all included. The timings below are the current 1.9 settings.[/center]

[center][spoiler]• Expanded farmer participation with matching replies, relationship-aware greetings, once-daily birthdays and optional farmer-started conversations.

• Added more contextual NPC-pair dialogue and finite linked exchanges of up to four lines.

• Added 2,640 character-specific heart-based spoken entries for the 34 original villagers, including greetings, personal topics, matching answers and goodbyes.

• Added gossip, dreams, worries, future plans and everyday problems, with friendship, story and privacy checks for deeper conversations.

• Added named pet, horse and farm-animal greetings, villager pet/horse questions, matched farmer replies and optional species-appropriate native sounds.

• Added morning spouse/roommate and pet greetings, including 78 spoken morning entries for the twelve original spouses and Krobus. Krobus remains platonic.

• Added Extra Frequent mode while keeping Frequent as the default. Eligible outdoor conversations can share the screen, with at most two STC bubbles visible.

• Improved reading reliability: walking away, going offscreen or warping keeps a displayed line; menus, native dialogue and scenes pause its remaining reading time.

• Introduced natural reply overlap while preserving each line’s full reading time. Farmer replies start after one second; NPC/animal replies start with one second left on the previous line.

• Added optional named chatter copies in local game chat, enabled by default, using the native recent-message history.

• Prioritised first daily greetings and allowed visible NPCs to move to fresh eligible topics without requiring the farmer beside them.

• Current timing choices are 4–8 seconds per bubble (8 default) and 6/8/10/12/14 seconds between crowded conversations (10 default). Separate feature switches retain player control.

• Preserved existing daily/festival writing, saved preferences, expansion companions and twelve earlier languages. Newer writing uses English fallback; prior downloads remain available.[/spoiler]
[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]💬 Conversations with character[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791484767-1805209379.png[/img]
[center]Added bubbles give no friendship, XP, items or other gameplay rewards.[/center]

[center]The heart-based expansion adds [b]2,640 spoken entries[/b] for original villagers. Your actual friendship and relationship determine eligible greetings and topics; private conversations wait for quiet surroundings. Original daily and festival writing stays available.[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791484793-925277658.png[/img]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Friendship and relationship dialogue[/color][/b]
Native-renderer examples of heart-based greetings and conversations. These are isolated previews, not screenshots from a live modpack. Text choices still follow actual hearts and relationships.[/quote][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🐾 Pets, horses and farm animals[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Greet your named pets, your own horse and nearby farm animals. Villagers can greet a horse in town, including while ridden, and ask about your actual pets or horse from four hearts. Matching farmer answers and optional native animal calls complete the exchange. Animal writing adds [b]363 spoken entries[/b].[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Named animal greetings[/color][/b]
Native-renderer animal dialogue examples. Actual names, species, relationships and availability decide which exchange can play.[/quote][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]☀ A familiar hello in the morning[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Separate on-by-default switches add morning spouse/roommate and pet greetings. After wake-up control settles, your actual nearby spouse or Krobus roommate has priority, followed by awake nearby pets. Either spouse or farmer can begin; general farmer-first conversations can remain off.[/center]

[center]The twelve original spouses and Krobus have [b]78 spoken morning entries[/b]. Krobus stays platonic. Completed exchanges count once daily, and pet morning hellos also count toward their ordinary daily greeting.[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791484928-1041527568.png[/img]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]A morning conversation[/color][/b]
Three successive moments in an authored Penny-and-farmer morning exchange. This preview does not show three bubbles appearing simultaneously.[/quote][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]📖 Keep time to read[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Full reading, even when you move[/color][/b]
Displayed lines retain their selected duration when you walk away, move offscreen or warp. Offscreen speakers use named edge bubbles. Menus, native dialogue, scripted scenes and focus interruptions hide and pause reading; safe play resumes the remaining time. Turning chatter off, changing settings or changing saves cancels the exchange.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Replies overlap naturally[/color][/b]
Farmer replies start one second after the addressed line appears. NPC and animal replies start with one second left on the previous line. Every line keeps its full independent reading time. There are at most two STC bubbles total, no actor has two lines at once, and linked exchanges end after at most four lines.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Catch up in game chat[/color][/b]
Show chatter in game chat is on by default and optional. Each displayed line appears once with its actual speaker name, including named animals. It stays local, leaves typing unfocused and uses the native ten-message recent history shared with normal chat.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Overlapping replies and local chat[/color][/b]
Native-renderer example of a villager opening, a farmer reply and their named local chat copies. Each bubble retains its own reading time.[/quote][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]⏱ Choose how lively the valley feels[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791485052-811705523.png[/img]
[center]Indoors and crowds use one conversation. Their selected break starts after the final line finishes.
Busy actors, native dialogue, distance and safety checks can delay an opportunity.[/center]

[center]First daily greetings get priority when a slot becomes free. After a break, eligible new topics can follow without walking away and returning. Visible NPCs can speak to each other or make ambient remarks elsewhere on the current screen; farmer-directed and private replies still need the farmer nearby.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]⚙ Make it your own[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791485125-130664148.png[/img]
[center]Relationship, birthday, heart-based chatter, gossip, goodbyes and animal features also have separate switches.
Existing greeting, reply, category, festival and excluded-villager choices remain available.[/center]

[center]Optional [color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color] provides separate feature switches, category choices and villager exclusions. Without GMCM, the generated config.json exposes the same settings. Independent farmer comments stay off by default and remain opportunity-based when enabled.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🎪 Everyday life and festivals[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Daily remarks cover personality, seasons, weather and location. Festival chatter supports the eight traditional festivals, Night Market, Desert Festival, Trout Derby and SquidFest, using actual present participants during safe free roaming. Ceremonies, contests and scripted phases take priority; unsupported festival days remain silent.[/center]

[center]STC uses native speech-bubble artwork and fonts without replacing dialogue or artwork. It does not move villagers, force their animations or schedules, award friendship or items, or consume gameplay reward randomness. Collision and availability checks help keep exchanges in the right place.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🧩 Requirements, companions and updating[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791485143-458874378.png[/img]
[center]Twelve existing languages remain. Newer heart, animal, morning and setting text uses English fallback.
Full live modpack, multiplayer/split-screen and physical-controller playtesting remains unverified.[/center]

[center]The separate [b]SVE 1.0[/b] companion needs no replacement for this update. New heart and morning writing covers original villagers; companion writing is unchanged. Existing companion registrations continue to share the same scheduler and bubble limits.[/center]

[center]The optional Muttering Farmer setting pauses only STC farmer speech. Simple Dynamic Dialogue remains independent; its optional 1.3 priority switch leaves native dialogue and other mods’ emotes alone. Full external compatibility has not been established by isolated checks.[/center]

[center]1. Install [color=#67E8F9][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color].
2. Extract the [b]SimpleTownChatter[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI.
4. Adjust optional settings through GMCM or config.json.[/center]

[center]Keep config.json and data/history.json when updating. Valid saved timings remain; a removed 12-second duration becomes 8 seconds, and removed 24/32/48-second crowded breaks become 10 seconds. Remove the mod folder to uninstall.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌍 Languages and feedback[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Earlier English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian content remains. Newer heart, animal, morning and setting text currently uses [b]English fallback[/b]; these additions are not fully translated into every language.[/center]

[center]If something goes wrong, please share a SMAPI log, your chatter mode, bubble duration and crowded-break settings, plus the location and participants. Native-renderer and isolated runtime checks have passed; full live modpack, multiplayer/split-screen and physical-controller testing remains pending.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🎨 Credits[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Stardew Valley and its native artwork and fonts belong to ConcernedApe. SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu are provided by their respective creators. The optional SVE companion credits Stardew Valley Expanded, FlashShifter and contributors; original expansion dialogue and artwork are not bundled.[/center]
